name: Disorder of Bile Acid Synthesis
aliases: Inborn Errors of Bile Acid Metabolism

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Bile Acid Synthesis Disorders

criteria.description: Detection of abnormal bile acid metabolites in urine or plasma by mass spectrometry
Clinical or biochemical evidence of cholestatic liver disease or progressive liver dysfunction
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes involved in bile acid synthesis (e.g., HSD3B7, AKR1D1)
Improvement of clinical and biochemical parameters following bile acid replacement therapy
Exclusion of other causes of cholestasis such as biliary atresia or metabolic liver diseases

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of abnormal bile acid profile plus either genetic confirmation or clinical evidence of hepatic dysfunction
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Early diagnosis is critical to prevent progressive liver damage and neurological complications.
